# Rojas Photography

> Professional corporate photography and video services based in Modesto, CA. Founded and operated by Alfonso Rojas. Specializing in executive headshots, on-site team photography, headshot booths, commercial photography, video production, and corporate event coverage across the Central Valley and beyond.

## Business Information

- **Business Name:** Rojas Photography
- **Owner and Lead Photographer:** Alfonso Rojas
- **Location:** Modesto, CA 95350 (Central Valley, California)
- **Phone:** 209-380-3727
- **Email:** alfonso@rojasphotography.net
- **Website:** https://rojasphotography.net

## Services

- [Premium Studio Headshots](https://rojasphotography.net/premium-headshots): Individual headshot sessions at the Modesto studio. $150 session fee + $150 per selected image. Unlimited wardrobe changes, real-time guided posing, 48-hour delivery. No minimum purchase required.
- [On-Site Photography](https://rojasphotography.net/on-site-photography): Alfonso brings a complete professional studio setup to your office, medical facility, or business. Priced per person. Ideal for contracted team headshots where each individual gets personal coaching and time.
- [Headshot Booth](https://rojasphotography.net/headshot-booth): High-volume event headshot service. Alfonso sets up at your expo, conference, or corporate event and moves attendees through efficiently. Priced by the hour.
- [Commercial Photography](https://rojasphotography.net/commercial): Brand imagery, facility photography, product shots, and marketing visuals for Central Valley businesses. 48–72 hour delivery.
- [Video Production](https://rojasphotography.net/video): Corporate video, brand stories, testimonials, culture videos, and FAA Part 107 certified drone footage.
- [Event Photography](https://rojasphotography.net/event-photography): Full corporate event coverage with real-time photo delivery via SpotMyPhotos facial recognition technology on full-day bookings. Trusted by Comcast, Save Mart, CLA, Valley First Credit Union.

- 500+ professionals photographed across Central Valley

## Pricing Summary

- Studio headshot session fee: $150
- Per image selected: $150 (no minimum, no package required)
- On-site team photography: custom quote based on team size and location
- Headshot booth: hourly rate, custom quote
- Commercial photography, video production, event coverage: custom quote

## Service Area

Primary: Modesto, CA
Also serves: Stockton, Turlock, Fresno, Sacramento, Merced, Ceres, Riverbank, Oakdale, Lodi, Tracy, Manteca, Clovis, and broader Central Valley region. Available throughout California for on-site engagements.

## About Alfonso Rojas

Alfonso Rojas is the founder, owner, and primary photographer at Rojas Photography. He has 15+ years of corporate leadership experience, giving him a unique ability to understand professional environments, executive expectations, and the business value of quality imagery. He is FAA Part 107 certified for drone operations. He guides every client through posing and expression in real time, which is why even camera-shy professionals come away with headshots they are proud to use.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Who is Alfonso Rojas?**
Alfonso Rojas is the owner and lead photographer of Rojas Photography, based in Modesto, CA. He has 15+ years of corporate leadership experience and is FAA Part 107 certified. He has photographed 500+ executives and professionals across the Central Valley and holds 60+ five-star reviews.

**What does Rojas Photography specialize in?**
Rojas Photography specializes in corporate and professional photography — executive headshots, on-site team photography, headshot booth events, commercial photography, video production, and corporate event coverage. All services are available in Modesto and throughout the Central Valley.

**How much does a headshot cost at Rojas Photography?**
A professional headshot session at Rojas Photography costs $150 for the session, plus $150 per image selected. There is no minimum number of images to purchase. For on-site team photography, headshot booths, and commercial projects, pricing is customized based on scope.

**Where is Rojas Photography located?**
Rojas Photography is based in Modesto, CA 95350. The studio serves clients in Modesto, Stockton, Turlock, Fresno, Sacramento, Merced, and throughout the Central Valley. On-site photography is available at client locations throughout California.

**Is Rojas Photography available for events outside of Modesto?**
Yes. Alfonso travels throughout the Central Valley and California for on-site team photography, headshot booth events, commercial shoots, and event photography. A travel fee applies for locations outside the immediate Modesto area.
